test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 29 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
The given sentence is divided into three segments. Select the option that has the segment with a grammatical error. If there is no error, select "No error".

She learnt / how to play a piano / when she was in Class 6th.
solution:
The correct answer is '4' i.e. how to play a piano .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence contains an error in the phrase **"how to play a piano."**
 
• The article **"a"** is incorrect here because the word **"piano"** is typically used with the definite article **"the"** when referring to playing the instrument.
 
• The correct usage is **"how to play the piano."**

Correct sentence: *She learnt how to play the piano when she was in Class 6th.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Usage of Articles:**

 
 
• **"The"** is used before instruments when talking about playing them, e.g., *"play the guitar," "play the piano."*
 
• **"A" or "An"** is used when referring to one among many or something non-specific, e.g., *"I bought a piano."*
 
 
 
• **Example Sentences:**
 
 
• She knows how to play the violin.
 
• He is learning how to play the drums.
